credit.credit-words: Who Is on the Lord’s Side?
WORDS: Frances R. Havergal, 1877; alt. MUSIC: “Rachie”; Caradog Roberts, 1921. Public Domain.

Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’S side? Ex. 32:26 Take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand. Eph. 6:13
